title: CESNET-TimeSeries26: A Multi-Year Network Traffic Time Series Dataset for Annual Seasonality, Concept Drift, and Long-Term Anomaly Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.14799v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Forecast-based models are fundamental to network traffic management and anomaly detection. However, it is essential to evaluate these forecasting models over extended periods of time in order to assess their adaptability to unexpected phenomena and shifts in underlying patterns. This kind of long-term evaluation requires multi-year data to account for yearly seasonality and behavioral drift. Existing public datasets are too short to support such long-horizon forecasting tasks. We introduce CESNET-TimeSeries26, comprising 995 days of continuous traffic time series from the CESNET3 network, together with a single subnet spanning approximately 4.5 years. The dataset captures 278,466 IP addresses, 285 institutions, and 566 institutional subnets at three aggregation intervals. translated_title: CESNET-TimeSeries26：一个用于年度季节性、概念漂移和长期异常检测的多年网络流量时间序列数据集
translated_abstract: 基于预测的模型是网络流量管理和异常检测的基础。然而，必须在较长的时间跨度内评估这些预测模型，以衡量其对意外现象和底层模式变化的适应能力。这类长期评估需要多年数据来反映年度季节性和行为漂移。现有的公开数据集时间跨度太短，无法支持此类长期预测任务。我们推出CESNET-TimeSeries26数据集，其中包含来自CESNET3网络的995天连续流量时间序列，以及一个跨度约4.5年的单一子网数据。该数据集在三种聚合时间间隔下记录了278,466个IP地址、285个机构和566个机构子网。该数据集为在运营管理和安全监控场景下评估预测模型提供了一个权威的纵向基准。我们证明了……
tldr: CESNET-TimeSeries26是一个时间跨度长达约4.5年的公开网络流量时间序列数据集，填补了现有数据集过短的空白，可用于长期评估预测模型应对年度季节性、概念漂移和异常的能力。
en_tdlr: CESNET-TimeSeries26 is a public multi-year network traffic time series dataset spanning up to ~4.5 years, enabling long-term evaluation of forecasting models for annual seasonality, concept drift, and anomaly detection.
